# Leaflet 1.9.4 (vendored)

BSD-2-Clause, see `LICENSE`. Copied unmodified from the npm package `leaflet@1.9.4` (`dist/`), so the site no longer
loads any script from a CDN. To upgrade: `npm pack leaflet@<version>`, replace `leaflet.js`, `leaflet.css` and
`images/`, update this file, and run the unit and e2e tests.
